Container.Name: anotherr
Container.Overview:
Anotherr checks your Plex library for bad media files. It syncs with Sonarr and Radarr, then samples random parts of episodes and movies on a schedule. It looks for corruption and truncated files, runtimes that don't match, the wrong audio language (original language preferred, dual audio preferred for anime), and subtitles that are missing, signs-only, out of sync, or dub captions. It also finds multi-episode files. Speech analysis uses faster-whisper on your NVIDIA GPU. It is Unraid-aware: it can scan one disk at a time or only disks that are already spinning, and it pauses during parity checks and active Plex streams (via Tautulli). Fixes go through Bazarr (new subtitles) and Sonarr/Radarr (blocklist + redownload), with approval by default. Automation is optional and runs on a schedule. Includes an MCP server for Claude Desktop that handles the visual checks, such as reading title cards.
GPU: requires the Nvidia Driver plugin. Set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to your GPU UUID (or 'all').
Container.Requires: Nvidia Driver plugin (for GPU speech recognition). Sonarr and/or Radarr. Optional: Bazarr, Tautulli.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web UI, REST API, webhooks and the MCP bridge talk to this port.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Database, settings and Whisper model cache (~2 GB for large-v3-turbo).

Config.Name: Unraid /mnt (read-only)
Config.Description: Read-only view of /mnt so files can be read from /mnt/user and traced to their physical /mnt/diskN for one-disk-at-a-time scanning. Set Path Mappings in the web UI (e.g. Sonarr's /tv -> /mnt/user/media/tv).

Config.Name: Unraid array state (read-only)
Config.Description: Used to detect parity checks and which disks are spun down. Remove it to turn those features off.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin page (e.g. GPU-xxxxxxxx), or 'all'.

Config.Name: API key (optional)
Config.Description: If set, the web UI, API, webhooks (?apikey=...) and the MCP bridge must send this key. Leave blank on a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run as (100 = users).
